description: The original regression fix plus repo-wide hygiene and documentation: scripts/start-local.sh loads .local/aadhaar-key.env and passes AADHAAR_ENC_KEY to the API process only (design §6); new auto-discovered guard scripts/aadhaar-digits-tests.ts with fixture sweep (§12.9); docs and parity notes (§7, §10). Plan items 13-15. start-local is independent of FEAT-001..003; the guard sweep and docs describe their final state, so this runs after them.
steps: Plan item 13 — scripts/start-local.sh: at top level and unconditionally, AFTER the `fi` that closes `if [ -f "$COGNITO_LOCAL_ENV" ]; then ... fi` (~113-116) and BEFORE `[ -n "$IDENTITY_LEGACY_BINDINGS" ] || ...`, add exactly the §6 block: AADHAAR_KEY_ENV="$PLATFORM_DIR/.local/aadhaar-key.env"; INHERITED_AADHAAR_ENC_KEY="${AADHAAR_ENC_KEY:-}"; unset AADHAAR_ENC_KEY; banner echo naming the file only (present: '» Aadhaar local key: .local/aadhaar-key.env (api only)'; absent: '» no .local/aadhaar-key.env — Aadhaar scans and saves will be refused (see docs/qa/tester-onboarding.md)'). Inside ONLY the API subshell `( cd "$RHUB_API_DIR"; ... ) &` (~254-266): AADHAAR_ENC_KEY=""; '# shellcheck disable=SC1090'; [ -f "$AADHAAR_KEY_ENV" ] && . "$AADHAAR_KEY_ENV"; then prefix the uvicorn env list with AADHAAR_ENC_KEY="${AADHAAR_ENC_KEY:-${INHERITED_AADHAAR_ENC_KEY:-}}" \. Note: `[ -f ] && .` as the last command of a failing test would trip set -e only if it is the final command of the subshell — it is not, but prefer `if [ -f "$AADHAAR_KEY_ENV" ]; then . "$AADHAAR_KEY_ENV"; fi` to be safe under set -e. Add a header comment line naming .local/aadhaar-key.env and the key NAME only. Never echo the value. Do not touch the e2e-web360 playwright configs.

Plan item 14 — create scripts/aadhaar-digits-tests.ts (Bun, no deps; follow the style of existing scripts/*-tests.ts such as scripts/vocab-tests.ts): list files with `git ls-files`, skip binaries, scan with /(?<![\d.])\d{4}[ -]?\d{4}[ -]?\d{4}(?![\d.])/g; allow (a) first digit 0 or 1, (b) synthetic (\d{4})\1\1 after stripping separators, (c) PATH_ALLOW entries {path, reason}. AADHAAR_CONTEXT = /aadha?ar|ఆధార్/i: entry rule — fail at load if any PATH_ALLOW path matches; line rule — a hit whose line matches is never path-allowed. Print only path:line for failures (never the value). Self-tests: build a positive synthetic run at runtime from parts (no literal run in the guard source), negatives for each allow rule, an allow entry named like aadhaar-fixture.ts must fail, and a non-synthetic hit on an Aadhaar-mentioning line in an allowed path must be reported. First run: read only path:line; for each Aadhaar-context hit replace the value with a synthetic form and update the test's expectations (likely services/api/tests/test_aadhaar_security.py, apps/mobile/tests/aadhaar.test.ts, tests/e2e-app/specs/07 and 19, DocSpineTests.swift leftovers, other test fixtures); for non-Aadhaar runs (Terraform account ids in backend.tf/s3.tf, byte ranges, ticket ids) add reviewed PATH_ALLOW entries with one-line reasons. Do not edit unrelated dirty files from other sessions beyond replacing digits if the guard flags them; if a flagged file is one of those (see context.json environment_constraints), prefer a PATH_ALLOW entry only when the hit is not Aadhaar-context, otherwise record it in findings and ask.

Plan item 15 — docs (use runbook-consistency; mark historical evidence instead of rewriting; tag compliance/architecture edits with 'retention change pending Reddy's compliance review'): docs/qa/tester-onboarding.md '## The local stack' (aadhaar-key.env gitignored, defines AADHAAR_ENC_KEY by name, generation one-liner python -c 'from cryptography.fernet import Fernet; print(Fernet.generate_key().decode())', API only, file wins over shell, absent -> named 503). docs/runbooks/aadhaar-kms-rollout.md: rewrite '## Implemented contract' for the vault model (aadhaar_vault, purpose=aadhaar-vault, record/vault/subject references, sweep + reconcile, opt-in card with safe filename + linkAadhaarCard, D3a isolation boundary and hardening options as open Reddy decisions), replace reveal text with 'Reveal is retired; no API returns the full number', mark '## Approval gate 2 — legacy migration' SUPERSEDED (keep text), add the §8.4 local procedure and the §8.5 prod procedure headed 'AWAITING REDDY'S APPROVAL; NOT TO BE RUN BY AGENTS', and the §13 deploy-overlap + rollback statement. docs/compliance/gdpr-dpdp.md (~13, ~46, ~85), docs/compliance/engineering-checklist.md (~7), docs/architecture/ai-system.md (~35 mermaid diagram: aadhaar_candidates records/last 4 + new aadhaar_vault KMS-ciphertext-only node; ~158-160), docs/architecture/ai-inventory.yaml (~148-154 privacy.aadhaar, candidate_store -> 'aadhaar_candidates + aadhaar_vault', apps/ios consumer note 'Aadhaar via the synchronous route (deviation)') per the design §7 table. docs/specs/2026-08-22-web-ios-parity-contract.md '### Recorded exceptions inside a twinned module': iOS synchronous Aadhaar read (deviation; sync-ios follow-up; Reddy decision), iOS on-device full reveal (DocSpine.firstIdentityNumber, AllDetailsScreen.swift:108, DocumentViewer.swift ~331-345; known divergence; Reddy decision), follow-ups (iOS card opt-in with linkAadhaarCard; link_aadhaar_card label in Display.swift; Expo card opt-in). Remove any apps/mobile doc claim of tap-to-reveal (grep apps/mobile for 'reveal').
acceptance_criteria: bash -n scripts/start-local.sh exits 0 and the key value is never echoed; the capture block sits after the cognito fi at top level; only the API subshell receives AADHAAR_ENC_KEY
bun run scripts/aadhaar-digits-tests.ts exits 0 with self-tests passing and reports only path:line on failure
All suites whose fixtures were changed still pass
Docs state the vault model, retired reveal, superseded gate 2, the local clear procedure, and the prod procedure as awaiting Reddy's approval
verification: bash -n scripts/start-local.sh && (command -v shellcheck >/dev/null && shellcheck -S warning scripts/start-local.sh || echo 'shellcheck not installed')
for s in scripts/*-tests.ts; do echo "── $s"; bun run "$s" || echo "FAILED $s"; done   (only TY-5 baseline may fail)

Also fails when a PATH_ALLOW entry no longer has any hit (keeps the list reviewed). Prints 'FAIL: Aadhaar-shaped number at path:line' only, never digits.
